description.zh: 健康检查URL，需要以`http://`开头，最大长度不超过255字符，例如：`http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html`。不传该参数，可不修改应用检查URL。
description.en: The health check URL of the application. The URL must start with `http://`, and can be up to 255 characters in length. Example: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html`. If this parameter is not specified, the health check URL of the application is not changed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas update-health-check-url --app-id c627c157-560d-43ff-000000000000000 --hc-url http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html --region cn-hangzhou
